preserves_prior_failure.interpretation: P-017 remains an immutable failed two-archetype single-head study; this request does not reopen its candidate or seed budget.

reason: The local portfolio spans many component types but shares one synthetic source, while P-017 reduced storage and thermal evidence to one common feature schema. Cross-component method selection must start with independent-source, level-aware data suitability and archetype-specific feature contracts rather than another local classifier fit.

requested_authority.scope: Stage X0 zero-fit cross-component and cross-source data readiness, adapter feasibility and exact next-protocol design only.
allowed_actions: Acquire official public datasets only after both Timer Stage X0 approval and separate project-owner network, storage and license approval; record URL, version, checksum and license receipt.
Read dataset schemas, channel dictionaries, labels, sampling metadata and provenance in an isolated profiling process.
Build declarative SourceAdapter, ChannelMap, feature-contract schemas and non-fitting contract tests.
Classify each dataset by usable task: detection, known classification, localization, open-set stress, representation or prognostics.
Define archetype-specific feature families and one common truth-blind evidence-token output contract.

Pre-register Stage X1 research reporting slices for source, component, condition and archetype holdouts plus macro, per-group, worst-group and end-to-end views; these slices may not replace or remove any frozen G1.1 formal denominator.
Submit a later exact development/calibration fit request that freezes architectures, dimensions, regularization, gate rules, seeds and finite candidate budget before model access.

initial_priority_sources.role: physical EPS detection and isolation adapter
large cross-mission detection and source-shift benchmark
pending-qualification industrial actuator and sensor cross-domain source

required_stage_x0_deliverables: versioned data-source x system-level x archetype x mechanism x observability x task-suitability matrix
license, security, provenance, duplicate and truth-leakage audit for every acquired source
archetype-specific feature-contract catalog with missing-channel behavior
declarative adapter feasibility receipts for at least three genuinely different sources or an explicit blocked result
leave-one-source, leave-one-instance and leave-one-archetype split proposal
exact finite-candidate Stage X1 request; no fitting before its separate Timer approval

not_authorized: Fit, fine-tune, pretrain or select any detector, encoder, expert, gate, classifier, localizer or threshold
Acquire external raw data without both Timer Stage X0 approval and separate project-owner network, storage and license approval
Create or reserve development, calibration or validation seeds
Search dynamic-gating topology, feature count, hidden dimension, expert count, regularization or conformal rules
Generate formal open-set classes or access hidden-acceptance truth
Bind a production model or start Stage B
Change G1.1 classes, thresholds, denominators or expand UNKNOWN/OOD
Report Stage X0, P-018, T-310, T-311 or G3 as performance PASS
approval_text_requested_zh: Timer 审批：我已审阅 P-017 完整失败证据、P-018 跨部件数据/方法矩阵和 ADR-003。我授权 Stage X0 零拟合跨部件、跨数据源的数据就绪、适配器可行性、原型专属特征合同和下一阶段精确协议设计；不授权任何模型训练、微调、特征选择、动态门控搜索、阈值选择、开发/校准/验证种子、正式开放类、生产拟合或 Stage B。G1.1 五项制品、故障分类、阈值、分母、600 秒预算、唯一 production-estimator manifest 和耗尽种子禁用规则保持不变。外部公开数据只能在本审批与项目负责人另行批准网络、存储和许可同时具备后获取，并必须记录来源、版本、许可和校验和。Stage X0 完成后，任何分层模型、原型专属编码器、动态门控或图定位拟合，都必须在模型、维数、正则化、门控规则、数据切分、种子和有限候选预算冻结后再次提交 Timer 审批。
claim_boundary: Pending zero-fit Stage X0 request only. It authorizes no raw-data acquisition without both Timer and separate project-owner approval, and no model fitting under any condition.
